description: Evaluates a group of 2-20 crops planted in the same bed. Discovers all pairwise relationships (beneficial and antagonist) among the crops in the input, deduplicates by canonical pair order, and surfaces warnings when one crop antagonizes 2+ others (the hub-antagonist pattern; fennel-herb is the canonical example). Returns `{ crops, beneficial[], antagonist[], warnings[] }`. Each pair is reported once; if both storage directions exist, the strongest edge is chosen. Accepts slugs or common names. Crops with no known relationship to any other crop in the bed are silently absent from the relationship lists.

crops.description: List of 2-20 crops to evaluate together (slugs or common names). Used by `plan_bed_compatibility` to discover all pairwise relationships within the bed.

items.description: Crop identifier: calendar slug ('tomato', 'pepper-sweet', 'fennel-herb'), common name ('Tomato', 'Sweet Pepper'), scientific name ('Solanum lycopersicum'), or alias. Case-insensitive. The tool resolves any of these to the canonical slug before lookup.

name: plan_bed_compatibility
title: Evaluate a Bed of Crops for Companion Compatibility
